messages:
Marie (CSM): Quick heads-up — Solstice pinged about a mid-term credit request and a signer rotation on their PO. They want a $12k credit applied pro rata and will send a new PO from a different procurement contact. Can finance/legal confirm constraints? @Tess (Finance) @Jorge (Legal) :eyes:

Priya (AM): Do we have the renewal/term that this credit should map to? Is this for current annual commitment or an add-on? Also who is the new procurement email so we can validate authority.

Marie (CSM): It's for the current annual (renewal date 2025-07-08). Solstice says one of their finance leads left; new requester is procurement_ops@solstice.com. They want the credit to reduce current invoice 2025-02-01 (INV-2025-6789).

Marie (CSM): Snippet they sent:
```
Invoice: INV-2025-6789
Amount: $48,000
Requested credit: $12,000 (pro rata for unused seats)
New PO: coming from procurement_ops@solstice.com
```

Tess (Finance): We can process a credit memo but need: 1) explicit PO referencing the original invoice or subscription id, 2) an authorization email from a registered approver on file (or a signed delegation). Without that we can't update AR. Net terms stay as-is. :+1:

Jorge (Legal): If the requester is outside our signer roster we need one of two things: (A) an email from the previously-authorized signer delegating authority to procurement_ops@solstice.com, or (B) a scanned delegation letter on company letterhead. Either works; option A is faster. Also confirm whether credit changes any SLA/term language — looks like just billing, so legal impact minimal.

Priya (AM): Plan proposal: ask Solstice for (1) PO that references INV-2025-6789 or subscription id, (2) quick delegation email from their prior approver (cc legal@solstice.com) OR a signed delegation doc, (3) we prepare a credit memo draft and route to Tess. If they can email delegation now we can issue credit memo same day and apply on next billing cycle.

Marie (CSM): I'll ask them to send both the PO and delegation email in one thread to reduce back-and-forth. I'll copy @tess_finance and @jorge_legal in the outbound.

Tess (Finance): Once we have PO + delegation, workflow: create credit memo CM-2025-045, link to INV-2025-6789, apply to account. Expect ~24-48h processing. Please put "apply to balance" in the PO notes.

Jorge (Legal): If they push for an immediate offset without delegation, escalate to legal ops and request proof of authority. We won't accept verbal approvals.

Priya (AM): I'll draft the templated ask for Marie to send. Quick copy-paste suggested message:

```
Hi Procurement — thanks. To process your request we need: 1) PO referencing INV-2025-6789 (or subscription id), 2) email from the previously-authorized signer delegating procurement_ops@solstice.com, or a signed delegation letter. Attach the PO and delegation to this thread and we'll route to Finance/Legal.
```

Marie (CSM): Sent to customer at 09:15 PT, included PO template and delegation doc sample. I'll drop the thread here when they reply. :handshake:

doc-bot: Saved thread to renewal-runbook (tag: midterm-credit).

Tess (Finance): Thanks — mark me OOO Fri morning but will pick up when back. If they send docs before then, please flag with "urgent-credit" tag so I triage.

Marie (CSM): Action items:
- Marie: follow up with Solstice and paste their reply here (ETA today EOD)
- Priya: finalise template text (done)
- Tess: process CM once docs arrive
- Jorge: standby for delegation review

Marie (CSM): tagging this as renewal risk (low) — operational only, no pricing change unless they ask for term change. Will update if they request prorate method details. :white_check_mark:
